skills.title: Record ledger entries
skills.description: Records a text entry in the ledger. Use when the user asks to log, add, or note something in their ledger.
skills.worthy: Writing to the ledger is the application's core action.
skills.would_use: When the user wants something kept in their ledger rather than in chat.
skills.how: Run ledger add with the entry text quoted.
skills.helps: Keeps the record in the application instead of an agent-invented file.
skills.demand: Every ledger session starts with adding entries.
skills.agent_gap: Agents tend to write notes to ad hoc files instead of the user's tool.
prerequisites: ledger is runnable from the application root
when_to_use: The user says to log or add an entry
when_not_to_use: The user only wants to read entries

examples.task: Log a note from a file

pitfalls: Unquoted text with spaces becomes several arguments

skills.title: Create an entry over HTTP
skills.description: Creates a ledger entry through the API. Use when the ledger runs as a service.
skills.worthy: The API is the only way to write when the CLI is not on the machine.
skills.would_use: When the agent talks to a deployed ledger.
skills.helps: Writes to the service without a shell on that host.

skills.title: Record an entry without echo
skills.description: Records an entry with a different example.

skills.title: Browse the ledger
skills.description: Opens the entry list for browsing.
skills.would_use: When a person wants to scroll.

rejected.name: make report
rejected.reason: A maintainer task, not something an agent is asked to do.
